<!-- pr-reviewer: 35b9c03545bb7282f9ce0fe117240c546edbced5 -->

**Needs changes before merge** - one process finding, no code defect.

## What looks good
- The guard in both posts is byte-identical to the reference guard in `assets/posts/tormach.cps`: same regex, same `- ` prefix, same comment. `assets/posts/tormach-lathe.cps:302-303`, `assets/posts/tormach-plasma.cps:94-95`.
- The machine-name comment (the reported hole, `tormach-lathe.cps` line 347 and `tormach-plasma.cps` line 128) is now guarded, and user comments via `onComment` are guarded too.
- Pinning tests for machine names that open with active keywords, for user notes, and for inert names (lathe, plasma): `crates/post/tests/tormach_lathe_post.rs`, `crates/post/tests/tormach_plasma_post.rs`.
- Existing golden suites stay green: the change touches only comment text.

## Results (local build, trial merge of origin/main b439de579 into head 35b9c035)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test tormach_lathe_post --test tormach_plasma_post` - 4/4 pass (run locally, `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6`, sccache).
- `script_tormach_lathe` 11/11, `script_tormach_plasma` 11/11 (recorded golden suites, no change from this PR).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` - clean.
- No example-catalog case uses the Tormach lathe/plasma posts (catalog cases use the Fanuc/Haas mill posts), so no catalog step is owed. No light-lane twin exists for this code (no `light lane` marker in `crates/post`). The issue is `P7`, so no targeted heavy step is owed.

## Requested before merge
1. Add a one-line reason in the PR body for the two new top-level test files (`crates/post/tests/tormach_lathe_post.rs`, `crates/post/tests/tormach_plasma_post.rs`). AGENTS.md "New tests join a directory suite": a new top-level file under `crates/*/tests/` needs a one-line reason in the PR body, or it belongs to `ISOLATED`/`SLOW_BINARIES`. Either add the body line, re-home the tests into a directory suite, or add the files to one of those lists.

## Notes
- The decisions doc (`docs/decisions/4231-tormach-comment-active-guard.md`) enumerates a short keyword list (`MSG`, `DEBUG`, `PRINT`, `LOG`, `PROBEOPEN`, `ABORT`, `AXIS`, `PY`) that is shorter than the regex, which also covers `LOGOPEN`, `LOGAPPEND`, `LOGCLOSE`, `PROBECLOSE` and `PYRUN`. Cosmetic - the code is the authority.
- The decision doc heading uses `#` while the README names `##` and lists "what was considered and dropped"; the file covers the same content in substance.
- The regex and the `- ` prefix are exactly those of the reference `tormach.cps` guard and the `comment_escape.rs` expectation, so the guard matches the LinuxCNC active-comment rule as the repo already implements it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 60e286dbe31e50d34c969c21cd5c5357d24db0cb -->

**Ready for the maintainer to merge** - the one process finding of the prior review is closed; no code defect.

## What looks good
- The guard in both posts is byte-identical to the reference guard in `assets/posts/tormach.cps`: same regex, same `- ` prefix, same comment text (`tormach-lathe.cps:302-303`, `tormach-plasma.cps:94-95`).
- The machine-name note (the reported hole) and user comments via `onComment` are both guarded by the same `note()` entry point.
- The PR body now carries the one-line reason for the two new top-level test files (`crates/post/tests/tormach_lathe_post.rs`, `crates/post/tests/tormach_plasma_post.rs`): isolates the post-specific active-comment guards into focused binaries. That closes the single requested item of the prior review (35b9c035).
- The changes are comment-only; the machine-name and user-comment tests pin the guard on both posts.

## Results (local, worktree off 60e286dbe)
Trial merge of `origin/main` into the branch went well; no conflicts; the trial merge was discarded. The PR head is a clean merge of main with no hand edits (`cargo xtask merge-plan --delta` classifies it SAME).

- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test tormach_lathe_post --test tormach_plasma_post` - 4/4 pass (lathe 2/2, plasma 2/2).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test script_tormach_lathe --test script_tormach_plasma` - 11/11 and 11/11 pass (recorded golden suites, unchanged by this PR).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` - clean.
- Merged-with-main tree: the above ran on a clean checkout of the head; no app-level suite was owed (no `example_catalog*` case uses the Tormach lathe/plasma posts - the catalog uses the Fanuc mill posts).

## Targeted tests (heavy / light)
- `P7` issue, not under the safety floor: no targeted heavy step is owed.
- `cargo xtask gate light` - 6/6 steps ok, wall 14.0 min (build ok in 318s; motion light lib ok in 433s; adaptive_troch_island ok in 54s; adaptive_troch_neck ok in 21s; adaptive_troch_parallel ok in 13s; app pocket_pass_start ok in 2s).

## Requested before merge
Nothing. The prior finding (one-line reason in the PR body) is closed by the current body.

## Questions / notes
- Cosmetic: `docs/decisions/4231-tormach-comment-active-guard.md` lists a shorter keyword set (`MSG`, `DEBUG`, `PRINT`, `LOG`, `PROBEOPEN`, `ABORT`, `AXIS`, `PY`) than the regex actually covers (`LOGOPEN`, `LOGAPPEND`, `LOGCLOSE`, `PROBECLOSE`, `PYRUN` too). The regex is the authority; the doc could match it next time it is touched.
- Fork PR: left ready as the contributor set it. The maintainer approves and merges by hand.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
